verses.text: The Lord is my hope: in Him I shall not be confounded.
For according to His glory He made me, and according to His goodness He gave unto me;
And according to His love He lifted me up, and according to His excellent beauty He set me on high;
And He brought me up from the depths of Hell, and from the mouth of Death He drew me.

section: And He Appeared to Me, the One Who Is the Lord
